messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG, Industrial & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Stanton Chase Dubai Team,

I am sharing my profile for retained and confidential senior leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. Stanton Chase Dubai's retained executive-search focus and work across senior leadership make this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major mining and infrastructure environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments. My strongest alignment is with industrial, mining and natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure, government-facing country leadership, corporate affairs and strategic partnerships.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential searches.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
